description: A fake fal MCP server for metrics-video: submit_job queues the ElevenLabs v3 voiceover (and a re-voice) and the ElevenLabs Music bed, each by its key mv-<stem>-<step> (a $pattern: any stem of 8 lowercase letters and digits) with its own request id and URLs. The grouped read (voiceover 0, music 1) completes the voiceover and FAILS the music with a 422 content-checker refusal. Each job read alone is answered too; any other jobs list gets a lookup error. get_submission answers not_found. Bills nothing.

get_pricing.description:
Get pricing information for fal.ai models. Returns cost per run or per second.
Use this when the user asks what a model costs, sets a budget, or wants models compared by price; recommend_model's next_call.price usually has the selected model's rate already. It isn't a required step before running a model. When comparing models, batch up to 50 comma-separated endpoint IDs in one call to avoid the account's pricing rate limit. Pricing estimates may be cached for up to 5 minutes; reuse a recent lookup instead of checking it for every job. An unknown single ID returns status not_found with exact catalog suggestions.

get_model_schema.description:
Get the input/output schema for a specific fal.ai model.
Returns every parameter the model accepts as input_params plus one inlined input_schema, what it returns as output_fields and output_schema, and the exact OpenAPI forms (exact_input_schema, exact_output_schema, components). Pass detail: 'compact' to omit the exact OpenAPI forms and the output schema.
Includes published guidance and v3 evidence in model_knowledge when available. Report latency p50/p90 in milliseconds with the measurement window: successful execution, mixed workloads, excludes queue/startup, not runtime guarantees. Null means unknown.
Not needed before running a model recommend_model selected: its next_call carries the complete input contract, and run_model/submit_job validate input against the live schema before any charge. Use this for a model you chose yourself or the user named. An unknown ID returns status not_found with exact catalog suggestions.
To compare several models, pass endpoint_ids: up to 10 compact schemas from one catalog read, instead of one call per model.

submit_job.description:
Submit a job to the queue WITHOUT waiting for completion. Returns immediately with a request_id.
Use this instead of run_model for long-running tasks (video generation, 3D, training).
Then call wait_for_jobs with a one-item jobs list containing index: 0 and the original endpoint_id, request_id, status_url and response_url. It includes ready results.
Pass a client-generated submission_key for recovery through the shared journal. Preserve it across retries, including its exact inputs and payer; use get_submission if the tool reply was lost. Never replace an uncertain key to retry. Unkeyed calls are not deduplicated.
Input is validated against the live schema before any charge; an invalid input returns field errors with the expected values and is never billed. When recommend_model selected the model, submit its next_call (endpoint_id, decision_id, input built from input_contract) right away: no schema, pricing or account check is needed first. For several variations or independent jobs, use one submit_jobs call.

wait_for_jobs.description:
Observe one or several existing jobs with a jobs list. For known completed jobs, set each item's read_mode=result in the same grouped jobs list; keep small multi-job results together. Use a one-item list only for a single requested job or when the group reply omitted that job's full JSON because of the byte limit. Preserve any continuation across those recovery reads. timeout_seconds=0 requests one snapshot. Read and wait for 1–32 existing fal jobs together (up to four submit_jobs groups), preserving caller indexes and input order. Waits up to 40 seconds per call and returns once every job has an outcome, with every completed, failed, pending, or inaccessible item and no hidden siblings. It never submits, cancels, or reruns generation.
A COMPLETED queue status is not success until its model result is retrieved. all_terminal means every job's outcome is confirmed; lookup_error and recovery_required do not prove generation failure. Keep all original handles. When pending, wait poll_after_seconds before another group read. Use one grouped display after the requested set is resolved.
